title: Elyndor ResourcePack
description: A resource pack that modifies the game menu based on Elyndor and its lore.
body:
# Elyndor Season 3 Resourcepack
![S3-logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd6053e7d781a719bc32eca5019b1a1dc6fb5d38.png)
This resource pack changes the appearance of the main menu by modifying the following:
- splashes (The yellow text often seen on the Minecraft logo)
- Panorama View
- Minecraft Logo

In particular, the splashes could contain clues and community refrences from the Elyndor community and even reveal previously unknown names that are important for the world-building of the Elynverse (Elyndor universe).
